Uniform even-parity H_n with n>=3 has independent proper coordinate subsets, so 1,x_i form an orthonormal family and the projection kernel is 1+sum_i x_i y_i=n+1-2d_H(x,y). Equal row/column absolute sums give the exact operator norms, with a sign-valued row extremizer. Splitting the full binomial sum by parity, using truncated alternating identities for binomial coefficients and j-binomial coefficients, gives the two closed central-binomial formulas and relative corrections; central-binomial recurrence yields all stated dimension reversals and ties. Independent exact binomial checks in dimensions 3..120, plus direct Gram/kernel construction through dimension 8, corroborated identities and n=3 boundary; these finite checks are not the all-n proof.
